files.name: motion-prompt-020.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Zoom through" (ズームスルー), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves".
Motion Prompt #020

What it is: Zooms into an object and passes through it into the next scene
What the sample shows: The camera pushes into the hole of a letter O and comes out in the next scene.
Spec:
- Scene X (ZOOM on yellow) → scene Y (GO! on blue) → scene X, 2.35 s each.
- The current scene is scaled around the centre of an O's hole (radius 24.5). Maximum scale is 1.08× the value at which the hole covers the whole frame (about 14×).
- Scale = maxScale^p (exponential zoom, which reads as constant speed).
- p = 0.8 × cubic ease-in (0.25–1.2 s) + 0.2 × cubic ease-out (1.2–1.65 s): accelerate in, slow down at the end.
- Inside the hole the next scene is placed at 1/maxScale. When the zoom ends it is exactly at full size, and the view switches to the next scene.
When to use it: Use it to dive into a logo or letter and move to the next scene with momentum.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/020.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
